# Product Mission

## Pitch

Rentzu is a mobile landlord bookkeeping app that helps small landlords stay tax-ready year-round by capturing rental income and expenses as they happen and turning them into clean, accountant-ready year-end summaries.

## Users

### Primary Customers

- **Small individual landlords**: Own a handful of rental properties/units and either file their own taxes with consumer tax software or hand their records to an accountant at year end.
- **Chinese landlords**: Small landlords in Chinese-speaking communities who want a simple, approachable way to keep rental records organized for their accountants.

### User Personas

**Small Landlord** (30-60 years old)
- **Role:** Owner / self-managing landlord
- **Context:** Owns 1-10 rental units; manages finances part-time alongside a day job.
- **Pain Points:** Receipts and rent payments scattered across notes/bank statements, scramble to assemble numbers at tax time, unsure which expenses are deductible.
- **Goals:** Capture income/expenses quickly, stay organized during the year, hand a clean package to their accountant or tax software.

**Accountant-Reliant Landlord** (35-65 years old)
- **Role:** Landlord who outsources filing to a CPA/accountant
- **Context:** Doesn't file themselves but must supply complete, categorized year-end data.
- **Pain Points:** Doesn't know what the accountant needs, provides messy or incomplete data, back-and-forth delays.
- **Goals:** Produce a Schedule E–style, CPA-ready export with minimal effort.

## The Problem

### Landlords aren't tax-ready until it's too late

Small landlords typically reconstruct a year of rental finances from memory, bank statements, and shoeboxes of receipts right before tax season. This wastes time and leads to missed deductions and messy handoffs to accountants.

**Our Solution:** Capture each income/expense the moment it happens (including by voice) and keep it categorized and tax-ready all year.

### Handoffs to accountants are messy and incomplete

Landlords who use an accountant often don't know exactly what data is required, so they submit disorganized records that trigger delays and follow-up questions.

**Our Solution:** Generate property-level, Schedule E–style year-end summaries and CPA-ready exports.

### Full tax software is overkill and intimidating

General accounting and tax-prep tools are complex and not tailored to rental real estate, especially for non-native-English speakers.

**Our Solution:** A focused, landlord-first mobile app that emphasizes the current tax year and simple rental categories.

## Differentiators

### Bookkeeping-first, not tax-prep

Unlike full tax-filing software, Rentzu deliberately focuses on keeping landlords tax-ready and producing accountant-ready exports rather than filing returns. This keeps the product simple, safe, and squarely useful for its users.

### Rental-specific and current-year focused

Unlike general-purpose expense trackers, Rentzu organizes everything by property/unit and emphasizes the active tax year with rental-specific categories that map to Schedule E.

### Low-friction, voice-enabled capture

Unlike manual spreadsheet workflows, Rentzu lets landlords speak a record and have it transcribed and structured automatically, reducing the effort of staying current.

## Key Features

### Core Features

- **Property & portfolio management:** Organize properties, units, and renters under workspaces (organizations).
- **Financial records:** Log income and expenses tied to properties/units with rental-specific categories, emphasizing the current tax year with quick edit/delete.
- **Voice capture:** Speak a record and have it transcribed and extracted into structured fields.
- **Tax-ready summaries:** Property-level annual summaries and Schedule E–style deduction breakdowns with estimated tax impact.
- **Portfolio summary:** Cross-property income/expense/net roll-ups per year.

### Handoff & Reporting Features

- **Accountant-ready exports:** Schedule E summary and property expense reports (PDF) plus a CPA-ready package.
- **Depreciation & capital improvements support:** Structured improvement logs feeding depreciation schedules.

### Account & Billing Features

- **Email auth:** Email signup with verification codes and JWT-protected, org-scoped access.
- **Language preference:** Per-user English / Chinese setting that also drives voice-to-text transcription.
- **Unit-based billing:** Stripe billing where the first property is free and additional properties/units are billed in simple bands.
